intent: Padding as LiveKit sends it outside 1.13.5-1.13.9: after the marker of each of frames 10, 25 and 40, 3 packets with the padding bit and no payload. The track buffer releases each as a sample of its own, and counts its sequence number as padding, so the frame after it still follows. 0 requests, 0 lost, every frame written. RED when the track buffer's depacketizer leaves an empty payload to the H.264 one: the jitter buffer drops the 9 padding packets. The track buffer then asks for a key frame at 2336 ms. h264-padding-payload passes that RED.
